records.title: SBI Personal Loan
records.scope: SBI Personal Loan only; not home loans or every SBI product.
facts: This personal-loan product is for salaried employees with an SBI Salary Package Account.
The published sectors are government, defence and corporate employment.
The source lists PAN, six months of salary slips and salary-account statements, employment evidence and ITR/Form 16 where applicable; KYC requirements depend on existing records.
Credit-score assessment follows bank internal policy; this source does not supply a universal approval score.

records.title: PMMY / MUDRA
records.scope: PMMY scheme overview, not an individual lender sanction.
facts: The scheme supports micro-enterprise term-loan and working-capital needs for non-agricultural and agriculture-allied activities.
Shishu covers up to INR 50,000; Kishore above INR 50,000 to INR 5 lakh; Tarun above INR 5 lakh to INR 10 lakh.
Tarun Plus covers above INR 10 lakh to INR 20 lakh only for entrepreneurs who previously borrowed and successfully repaid under Tarun; the stated introduction date is 2024-10-24.
Lending is through participating banks, NBFCs and microfinance institutions.
unknowns: Individual lender rate and document checklist

records.title: PMEGP new enterprises
records.scope: New-enterprise route only; existing-unit upgradation is a separate route.
facts: Applicants must be older than 18 years.
For the new-enterprise route, assistance is for new projects; existing units and units already receiving government subsidy are excluded under the stated conditions.
Class VIII completion is required where project cost exceeds INR 10 lakh in manufacturing or INR 5 lakh in business/services.
Banks independently assess project viability. Prior subsidy, activity restrictions and the full scheme conditions must be checked.
